finding: The baseline Streamlit document paints white before the React app applies the selected theme. An early color-scheme meta tag and inline CSS in index.html fixes this while retaining the existing automatic light/dark theme config. The review-desk launcher now makes a temporary overlay with symlinks to installed static resources and its own customized index; it applies Streamlit's internal static-directory hook only in the launcher process and only before route construction. The installed package files and 23 MB asset bundle are not modified or copied.
